apiFacts.exports: package.json maps ./sdk types and import to ./src/sdk/index.ts; sdk index exports lifecycle and router namespaces; router index exports SessionRouter; lifecycle index exports service.
apiFacts.lifecycle: lifecycle.createSessionLifecycleService(agentDir) plus create/fork/resume/close/delete/list use actor, capability, requestKey mutation idempotency, explicit success/failure certainty, and continuationCursor list traversal.
apiFacts.routerRequest: SessionRouter.request(sessionId, frame, expectedGeneration?, expectedAttachment?, { timeoutMs?, beforeDispatch?, onDispatch? }?) returns Promise<Record<string, unknown>>, is the sole settler, and rechecks attachment/generation after response.
apiFacts.query: Validated generic request envelope: { type: "query_request", query: string, input?: Record<string, unknown>, cursor?: string }. Parse every response before following continuationCursor; malformed, stale, timeout, or transport-close results are non-authoritative/uncertain.
apiFacts.terminalCancellation: Validated generic request envelope: { type: "control_request", operation: "turn.abort", input: { mode: "terminal", scope: "turn" | "owned" }, idempotencyKey: string }. Router.request supplies transport request correlation through its request frame; the public terminal control contract source-binds mode, scope, and idempotency key. Parse acknowledged terminal result; timeout, transport close, malformed response, or stale attachment is uncertain.
apiFacts.generationStatus: SessionRouter.generationStatus(sessionId: string, endpointGeneration: number): Promise<SessionGenerationStatus>. Values are current, retired, replaced, or unknown. Evidence source is session_index with observedIndexSeq and evidenceIndexSeq; retired includes host_unregistered, session_closed, or session_deleted. Replaced includes currentGeneration.
apiFacts.positiveRetirement: Retired is positive only from a retained exact terminal index event matching registration incarnation, pid, and state root. Terminal evidence older than policy maxAgeMs returns unknown/proof_expired. Reused/ambiguous/incomplete/missing evidence never proves retirement.
apiFacts.protocolEvidence: Official docs/sdk.md and SDK CLI/host implementation source bind generic public Router.request envelopes: query_request, control_request, query response pagination, terminal turn.abort acknowledgement, validation, and uncertainty. These files are evidence only; production imports remain @gajae-code/coding-agent/sdk only.
apiFacts.lifecycleEvidence: service.ts validates actor id/namespace, capability, requestKey and target; derives SHA-256 idempotency from canonical actor namespace/id/requestKey/operation; maps broker/transport failures to terminal/retryable/cleanup_pending/uncertain; validates success results. client.ts implements createExternal/resumeExternal. session-list.ts rejects malformed, repeated cursor, and page-budget-exhausted traversal.
